We had a great experience with Masurkar Travels during our 5-day trip from Mumbai to Chikkamagaluru. We rented an Innova Crysta Diesel Automatic, and the entire journey (around 2200 km) was smooth and hassle-free.

Right from the start, they ensured the vehicle was in excellent condition — even taking care of the engine oil beforehand, which gave us extra confidence for such a long drive. What we really appreciated was the flexibility they offered when we were confused between a 7-seater and 8-seater, especially since we were traveling with 7 adults and 2 infants. Their guidance helped us make the right choice.

Overall, the service was reliable, thoughtful, and customer-focused. I would definitely recommend Masurkar Travels over self-drive options like Zoomcar, and I’d happily book with them again for future trips — hopefully next time with a brand new car 😅

featured_reviews.name: NiLESH GADRE
featured_reviews.review_text:
*★★★★★ Extraordinary Service from Kandivali East to Pune – Last-Minute Booking Saved My Day*

I had to travel urgently from my home in *Kandivali East to Pune* and called Samartha Travel for a *last-minute booking* with zero expectations. What I got was nothing short of exceptional.

*Punctuality: 10/10*
I called at short notice and they confirmed immediately. The driver was at my doorstep *15 minutes early*, car ready, tank full. In Mumbai, that’s rare. We left exactly on time and reached Pune _before_ the estimated time despite traffic at Lonavala ghat.

*2. Cleanliness: Immaculate*
The car was spotless – seats, mats, windows, even the door handles. Fresh fragrance, sanitizer, water bottles, and tissues provided. It felt like a brand-new car. You could tell they take pride in their fleet.

*3. Driver Behaviour: Professional + Human*
My driver, SAGAR, was the definition of courteous. Helped with luggage without asking, checked if AC temperature was okay, played soft music when he saw I wanted quiet, and drove incredibly smoothly on the Expressway. No rash overtakes, no phone calls while driving, no unnecessary chatter – just calm, respectful service. Felt 100% safe the entire 3-hour journey.

*4. Transparency: Zero Surprises*
Fare was quoted clearly on the phone. No surge, no “extra waiting charge”, no last-minute toll drama. What they said is exactly what I paid. Got a proper bill on WhatsApp right after the trip. That honesty is everything.

*The bottom line*: When you’re booking last-minute, you expect chaos. Samartha Travel gave me peace. From home pickup to dropping me at my native place in Pune, it was seamless, dignified, and stress-free.

If you need a car service you can blindly trust – for family, elders, or solo travel – *book Samartha Travel*. They don’t just drive cars, they deliver reliability.

_Will never use anyone else for Mumbai-Pune now. Thank you Samartha team for being there when it mattered most._

Explore Rajasthan’s timeless forts, golden deserts, and vibrant festivals this winter. From Jaisalmer’s desert safaris to Jaipur’s festive bazaars, Rajasthan offers culture, history, and adventure in one epic winter getaway. Travelling to Rajasthan during winter ensures comfortable weather for sightseeing and outdoor experiences.

The Pushkar Camel Fair 2025 is one of India’s most vibrant cultural events, held in the holy town of Pushkar, Rajasthan. This annual mela blends camel trading with folk music, desert sports, and spiritual rituals at Pushkar Lake, offering visitors a unique experience of Rajasthan’s desert culture.

From colourful markets to breathtaking sunsets, the Pushkar Mela Rajasthan attracts travellers, photographers, and culture enthusiasts from around the world.

Winter is the perfect season to explore wildlife destinations in India. From spotting majestic tigers to watching migratory birds and exploring lush forests, India’s national parks and wildlife sanctuaries offer unforgettable experiences. With pleasant weather and increased wildlife activity, winter safaris are ideal for nature enthusiasts and photographers alike.

From Goa’s vibrant parties to Kerala’s serene shores, India’s beaches offer the perfect escape for ringing in the New Year. Whether you are seeking lively celebrations, tranquil sunsets, or adventure by the sea, the country’s diverse coastline caters to every traveller. These beach destinations in India promise relaxation, festivities, and unforgettable experiences for the festive season.

Winter in India brings a magical transformation to the mountains, turning landscapes into snowy wonderlands. For travellers seeking frosty adventures, the country offers numerous snow tourist places in India where you can witness breathtaking peaks, frozen lakes, and soft blankets of snow. From Himachal Pradesh to Arunachal Pradesh, these destinations promise unforgettable experiences for both adventure seekers and leisure travellers.

Whether it’s skiing, snowball fights, or cosy evenings in mountain cabins, the best snowfall places in India create memories that last a lifetime.

The Sunburn Festival Mumbai is all set to bring a new wave of energy to India’s financial capital in 2025. After years of electrifying audiences in Goa and Pune, this celebrated electronic dance music (EDM) event is returning to Mumbai — the city that never sleeps. Fans can expect world-class performances, incredible visuals, and an unforgettable atmosphere as the Sunburn party takes over Mumbai’s nightlife once again. The move to Mumbai promises greater accessibility, improved infrastructure, and an opportunity for fans to experience the festival on its grandest scale yet.

A journey from Jaipur to Jaisalmer by road is one of the most scenic and exciting routes in Rajasthan. Travelling through royal cities, desert landscapes, and vibrant towns, this drive captures the essence of Rajasthan’s culture and history. The road is well-maintained, offering smooth travel with plenty of places to explore along the way.
